query:
-- Check for write-ins still in any candidate slot
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate2_name
FROM house_races
WHERE candidate1_name LIKE '%write%' OR candidate2_name LIKE '%write%'
   OR candidate1_name LIKE '%Write%' OR candidate2_name LIKE '%Write%';

-- Check for same-name duplicates in candidate1/candidate2
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status
FROM house_races
WHERE candidate1_name IS NOT NULL 
  AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL
  AND candidate1_name = candidate2_name
LIMIT 10;

-- Quick status summary for tonight's states
SELECT state_code, status, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code IN ('GA','KY','OR','PA','WV','NE','ID')
GROUP BY state_code, status
ORDER BY state_code, status;
